title: Gundam’s Smartest Move Was Going Full Dragon Ball With This Turning Point Anime
content: Mecha, political, space operas step aside – many fans were introduced to the Gundam franchise by the martial arts-focused, cheesy Mobile Fighter G Gundam . An anime series that felt like Dragon Ball Z in the form of giant robots.
author: ComicBook

title: Nao Emoto Launches Manga of Mokuyōbi ni wa Cocoa o Novel
content: Manga creator Nao Emoto launched a new manga based on Michiko Aoyama's Mokuyōbi ni wa Cocoa o novel on the websites for Takarajimasha 's Takarajima Sugoi! Web and Takarajimasha 's Liniere fashion and lifestyle magazine on Tuesday. The original novel's story centers on a cafe.
author: ANN

title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Knocks Daima Out of the Anime’s Timeline Again
content: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is now in the midst of its new remake anime run this Fall, and unfortunately the newest episode has once again knocked the events of Dragon Ball Daima out of the anime’s timeline to make it all that much more confusing.
author: ComicBook

title: Rin Shimokawa's 'Godmother' Manga from Young Magazine US Starts Seralization on November 18
content: The original one-shot centered on Kinryu, a college girl who is suddenly forced to drop out of college and move overseas to Japan. She goes to take care of a 114 year old grandmother whom she did not even know existed.
author: ANN

title: Legendary Isekai Releases New English Dub for Reboot After 32 Years
content: It’s been 32 years since this legendary Isekai anime series first made its debut, and now Magic Knight Rayearth has kicked off a new era with the start of its English dub release for the new reboot anime. CLAMP’s Magic Knight Rayearth is one of the most legendary anime franchises of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: The Simpsons Showrunner Teases Apu’s Future Following Recast
content: The Simpsons has officially reintroduced Apu back into the animated series after a nearly decade long absence, and the showrunner behind it all teases we’ll see much more of him in future episodes.

title: Demon Slayer Teases Jump Festa 2027 With New Update
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba is one of the many franchises taking the stage during Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event coming later this year, and now it’s teasing more of what fans can expect with a new update.
